text:
nina: Noticed a brief spike in client reconnects and "keepalive" timeouts right after we toggled the new graceful-close flag in the WS proxy canary at 14:20. No full outage but some customers saw streams drop and then quickly reattach, which produced duplicated resume attempts.

rick: Which flag exactly? the "graceful_close_window_ms" change?

nina: Yep. It went from 2s -> 50ms in canary so proxies close faster when idle. I think clients that expected a slightly longer socket linger reconnected and hit fallback routing.

oliver: Console shows a cluster of stale-seq warnings and a sudden jump in reconnects for route eu-west-1 between 14:20:12-14:21:05. Also sampling of resume spans is low (1%) so we only have a few traces.

tasha: Repro locally: start a long-lived WS -> let it idle -> flip graceful_close to 50ms -> connection gets ECONNRESET -> client reconnects and sometimes sends resume twice. Script below.

```
# repro
python -m websocket_client --url wss://api.redwood/stream?client=test &
sleep 1
# flip config
curl -XPOST "https://console.internal/api/configs/toggle?key=proxy.graceful_close_window_ms&value=50"
sleep 1
# watch reconnect
pkill -HUP websocket_client; sleep 2
```

rick: Two immediate mitigations: 1) revert the window to 2s in canary and pause rollout, or 2) add a short client-side backoff to avoid immediate double resume. Revert is the fastest.

nina: Can we instead increase resume dedupe TTL server-side? If we treat duplicate resume attempts within 3s as the same session, billing/counting won't double. Might be less invasive than rollback.

oliver: Dedupe TTL helps but still impacts UX (extra reconnect latency). Also console dashboards need to show this rollout linked to reconnect spikes. Right now the rollout dashboard doesn't annotate reconnect metrics.

tasha: Ops wants an alert rule while we triage: if ws-reconnects > 10/min AND resume-dedupe-alerts > 0 then page SRE. Can someone add that?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Created change cfg-202405 to set proxy.graceful_close_window_ms=2000 for canary and bump tracing.resume_sample=0.10. Rolling to 4 hosts.

rick: Also propose a short-term UX change: console should surface per-route "linger_window_ms" and show a bordered indicator when it's changed in last 24h. Product can decide wording but this would reduce surprise.

nina: Agreed. For now hotfix rollback + sampling to 10% so we can get more traces. After that we'll discuss the dedupe TTL and a more conservative rollout strategy (gradual ramp + post-rollout sampling boost).

oliver: After cfg-202405 applied reconnects returned to baseline within ~90s and duplicate resume events dropped to near-zero. We'll keep increased resume sampling for 12h and monitor.

tasha: Filing follow-ups: INT-431 reconcile-linger-window-console, INT-432 resume-dedupe-3s, INT-433 rollout-post-sample-boost.

nina: Incident note: rapid graceful-close can cause client immediate-reconnect loops; mitigated by rolling back linger window + increasing resume sampling + alert rule. No major user impact but next time we should annotate rollouts in the reconnect dashboard. :eyes:
